controller_6m.notes: Quote verified verbatim on p288 under 'Undertakings by the Controlling Shareholders' (Rule 10.07). CONVENTION CORRECTION: 'ending on the date which is six months from the Listing Date' ends the First Six-Month Period ON the anniversary 2026-12-03, which is therefore the last restricted day; first free day is 2026-12-04.

corrections.basis: Rule 10.07(1)(a): no disposal in the First Six-Month Period ending ON the date which is six months from the Listing Date (2026-12-03, inclusive); first free day 2026-12-04

controller_12m.notes: Quote verified verbatim on p288 (six months from expiry of the First Six-Month Period). DATE CORRECTION: the second period runs to and including the 12-month anniversary 2027-06-03; first free day is 2027-06-04. No longer lock-ups found (p321 'twelve months' hit is a going-concern statement).

corrections.basis: Rule 10.07(1)(b): no disposal in the six months from expiry of the First Six-Month Period, running to and including the 12-month anniversary 2027-06-03, to the extent it would cause cessation of controlling shareholder status; first free day 2027-06-04
